name: keep_or_move_date
description: After the months-to-save figure is worked out by modules, the agent puts keeping or moving the date to the person as a judgment call, recorded against step m4.
lines: If I can only put aside 400 a month, how long until I can pay for the move? The deposit is 1,200 and the van hire is 380. I will pay three months of overlapping rent at 950 a month, and I have no other costs. I have saved 1,000 so far, not counting my emergency fund, and the move is in 7 months. Please go ahead with those figures. Then help me decide whether to keep the move date or move it.
